cohort: The study included 120 women (mean age 31.5 years) who received fondaparinux for at least 7 days pre-, peri- and/or postpartum for prophylaxis or VTE treatment at German specialist centers between 2004 and 2010.
finding: Fondaparinux was found to be effective, with no VTE events or increased liver enzymes during treatment, and generally well tolerated, despite a small number of adverse events including bleeding, abortion, premature births, stillbirth, arrested labors, injection site erythema, and drug hypersensitivity.
